Just a week after Lorenzo Araujo’s death, ICE agents have taken another life, this time in Maine. I’m praying for the victim’s loved ones while they mourn this loss.

Trump’s fascist agents can’t continue to be allowed to terrorize our neighborhoods.

ICE must be abolished to protect our communities.

I'm running to go back to Congress now to deliver for our neighbors who have been neglected by Ill-prepared representation.

Unsurprisingly, our current Congressman remains silent about it.

When I’m back in Congress, I’ll fight to stop data centers from coming to St. Louis, so that we don't repeat history and let our families and children suffer the consequences.

My prayers are with the victims' families and all who are grieving after this tragedy.

Today, we remember the 8372 lives lost in the Srebrenica genocide.

At the Sebilj of St. Louis, we mourned those murdered 31 years ago, keeping their memory alive to ensure that history can never repeat itself or be rewritten.

But the genocide is not ancient history. Srebrenica is in the living memory of countless families both in Bosnia and here in St. Louis who lost their brothers, sons, and fathers.

I’m proud to stand with St. Louis’ Bosnian community to commemorate thousands of Bosnian men

I am saddened and angered by the bomb threat directed at Dar-ul-Islam, the largest mosque in our area, yesterday morning.

Islamophobia has become all too common in our current political environment. This kind of anti-Muslim bigotry has no place in St. Louis, or anywhere else. I'm thankful that nobody was harmed by this act of hate, and I am praying for everyone in our St. Louis Muslim community whose safety was threatened.
